question: Should OpenClaw V1 support `api.registerReadinessCriterion` and `gateway.readiness` as durable public Plugin SDK and configuration contracts?
rationale: This choice determines a compatibility-maintained external plugin API and an operator-visible readiness failure mode; code review cannot choose that product boundary safely.

options.title: Approve the V1 contract
options.body: Accept the public callback and selector identifiers as supported surfaces, then require focused upgrade and live-runtime proof before landing.

options.title: Defer the public plugin contract
options.body: Keep readiness ownership internal or postpone the plugin registration API until maintainers sponsor its compatibility and support model.

recommendation.title: Defer the public plugin contract
recommendation.body: Keep readiness ownership internal or postpone the plugin registration API until maintainers sponsor its compatibility and support model.
